text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Tartu city council declared illegal the resolution banning tobacco and alcohol advertisements in the city.
- Universities reports that there has been an unexpectedly large number of secondary school graduates applying for admission.
- The first naval naval officers since the pre-war period will graduate today.
- Hoiupank and Tallinna Pank are in merger talks, the paper reports.
